baseline_comparison.limitation: Original capacity-four baseline was imported from an earlier allocation whose overall run status is failed; only its completed valid baseline is included. The baseline ratio can include variation between physical GPUs or nodes and does not isolate a server-capacity effect. The capacity-32 concurrency comparisons use only the primary run.

gpu_telemetry_all_run.measurement: Sampled telemetry log values; sampled maxima are not continuous-time peaks.
gpu_telemetry_all_run.timestamp_time_zone_assumption: nvidia-smi node-local timestamps interpreted as America/Los_Angeles

limitations: Single ascending concurrency sweep is preliminary; no robust optimum is established.
Quick sweep uses fixed total work. Long-decode checks use one full concurrent batch, so request count and total work increase with concurrency and are reported separately.

Custom standard-library client uses /v1/completions with deterministic token-ID synthetic prompts, recorded sampling settings, ignore_eos, and forced output lengths; this is not the official vllm bench serve command and does not assess answer quality.

Sampling parameters match production (temperature 1, top_p 0.95, top_k 20, seed 42). The synthetic /v1/completions workload still differs from production chat/thinking prompts and natural stopping, so identical evaluation throughput or the same best concurrency is not established.
No extrapolation to P16: its roughly 44k-token shared-prefix prompts and B200 hardware differ from this A100 workload.
GPU maxima come from sampled logs filtered to the observed server GPU UUID; missing telemetry is left unavailable. Node-local nvidia-smi timestamps are interpreted as Pacific time.

Original capacity-four baseline was imported from an earlier allocation whose overall run status is failed; only its completed valid baseline is included. The baseline ratio can include variation between physical GPUs or nodes and does not isolate a server-capacity effect. The capacity-32 concurrency comparisons use only the primary run.
measurement_type: synthetic serving throughput, not biological benchmark scores

notes: No scored evaluation records read by benchmark client.
Paired fixed-total-work sweep uses32 identical192-token prompts and512-token forced outputs.
Long-decode check uses one full concurrent batch per level,4096 forced output tokens per request; batchsize scales withconcurrency, so totalworkdiffers and should be reported separately.
